connect.title: Connect qBittorrent
connect.body: Sign in with your qBittorrent Web UI username and password. The Kinopeer server keeps them, so you only do this once.
connect.banned: Too many failed attempts. qBittorrent has blocked this address for a while.
connect.unreachableBody: Check that qBittorrent is running and its Web UI is on.
connect.unreachableBody_kinopeer: Check that this device is online and Kinopeer is running on your server.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.emptyBody: Find a movie or series and pick a release — it shows up here with live progress.

speedLimits.failed: Couldn’t switch the speed limits. Try again.

search.title: Search
search.noResultsBody: Check the spelling or try the original title.
search.noResultsYearBody: Nothing from {{year}}. Try another year or clear it.
search.errorBody: Check the connection and try again.
search.keyBody: Search needs a TMDB key. Enter it once and the Kinopeer server keeps it.
search.browseEmptyBody: TMDB has no picks at the moment. Try again later, or search by name.

title.subtitle: {{type}} · {{year}}
title.notFoundBody: TMDB has no movie or series with this link.
title.seriesHint: Releases are searched by show name. Pick seasons in the file list after choosing a release.

settings.title: Settings
settings.prowlarrSetup: Not set up, or the API key was rejected
settings.tmdbKey: The API key is missing or invalid
settings.connectionsHint: Service addresses are set in the Kinopeer server configuration.
settings.defaultsHint: Used when adding a release, the same on every device. You can still change them for each download.
settings.clearCacheHint: Matches torrents to TMDB titles again
settings.installAppHint: Add Kinopeer to your home screen or dock
settings.ideasHint: In Discussions on GitHub, where ideas are upvoted
settings.reportBugHint: An issue on GitHub with the steps and your versions
settings.sourceCodeHint: Source code, releases and what's changed
settings.tmdbSource: Movie and series data and posters come from TMDB.
settings.tmdbNotice: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

releases.title: Releases
releases.noneBody: Your indexers returned nothing for this title. Try again later or check indexers in Prowlarr.
releases.setupBody: Set PROWLARR_URL and PROWLARR_API_KEY on the Kinopeer server, and check the key in Prowlarr → Settings → General.
releases.errorBody: Check that Prowlarr is running and reachable from the Kinopeer server.

add.title: Add to downloads
add.lowSpace: {{free}} free on qBittorrent’s disk, {{missing}} short of this download.
add.lowSpaceSkip: Skip some files or free up space before it finishes.
add.lowSpaceFree: Free up space before it finishes.
add.fetchFailed: Couldn’t get the torrent from Prowlarr.
add.magnetFiles: Magnet link: all files are downloaded. You can skip files later in qBittorrent.
add.addFailed: qBittorrent didn’t add the torrent. It may already be in your downloads.

torrent.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted from qBittorrent.
torrent.errorBody: qBittorrent stopped this torrent because of an error, usually a disk or save path problem. Fix it, then resume.
torrent.missingFiles: The files are missing from the save path. Put them back and resume, or delete the torrent.
torrent.recheckNoMetadata: Once the magnet link has its metadata
torrent.recheckBody: qBittorrent will read the downloaded data of “{{title}}” again. The torrent shows as checking until it’s done, and pieces that fail the check are downloaded again.
torrent.deleteBodyMany_one: {{count}} torrent will be removed from qBittorrent.
torrent.deleteBodyMany_other: {{count}} torrents will be removed from qBittorrent.
torrent.deleteFilesHint: Files are removed from disk permanently.
torrent.priorityFailed: Couldn’t change the priority. Try again.
torrent.filesMetadata: The file list appears once the torrent’s metadata arrives from peers.

match.guessNote: Matched by the release name. Is it right?
match.noTitle: No title found for this release.
match.hint: Your choice is saved on the Kinopeer server and shows on every device.
match.saveFailed: Couldn’t save the choice. Try again.

offline.title: No connection to qBittorrent
offline.unreachableBody: Check that qBittorrent is running and the Kinopeer server can reach it. Retrying automatically.
offline.unreachableBody_kinopeer: Check that this device is online and Kinopeer is running on your server. Retrying automatically.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.body: Kinopeer hit an unexpected error. Reload the page to continue.

install.title: Install Kinopeer
install.body: Full screen and a faster launch, like a regular app.

ios.title: Add to Home Screen
ios.subtitle: iPhone and iPad
ios.share: Tap Share in the Safari toolbar
ios.confirm: Tap Add, and Kinopeer opens full screen

mac.title: Add to Dock
mac.subtitle: Safari on a Mac
mac.share: Click Share in the Safari toolbar
mac.confirm: Click Add, and Kinopeer opens in its own window

tmdbKey.title: Connect TMDB
tmdbKey.body: Posters, search and metadata come from The Movie Database. Use a free API key (v3) or read access token. The key stays on the Kinopeer server.
tmdbKey.help: A key is free: sign in to themoviedb.org and copy the API Key or the API Read Access Token.
tmdbKey.label: API key or read access token
tmdbKey.fieldHelp: Kinopeer checks it with TMDB before saving.
tmdbKey.unreachable: TMDB isn’t answering. Try again in a moment.
tmdbKey.storage: The Kinopeer server couldn’t save the change. Check that its data folder is writable.
tmdbKey.failed: Couldn’t save the key. Try again.
tmdbKey.noFallback: Kinopeer has no other TMDB key to use, so the saved one stays.
tmdbKey.forgetFailed: Couldn’t forget the key. Try again.

move.title: Move files
move.absolute: Type the full path, starting with / (or a drive such as D:\ on Windows).
move.note: qBittorrent moves the files in the background, and the torrent carries on from the new folder. It keeps its category, but the category no longer decides its folder.
move.noAccess: qBittorrent has no access to that folder.

category.title: Category
category.moves: qBittorrent will move the files to {{folder}}.
category.movesToCategory: qBittorrent will move the files to the category’s folder.
category.stays: The files are in this category’s folder already: {{folder}}.
category.toManual: qBittorrent will switch the torrent to manual mode, as its settings say, and the files stay in {{folder}}.
category.manual: The torrent is in manual mode, so the files stay in {{folder}}.

prowlarrKey.help: Find the key in Prowlarr: Settings → General → Security → API Key.
prowlarrKey.label: Prowlarr API key
prowlarrKey.fieldHelp: Kinopeer checks it with Prowlarr before saving. It stays on the Kinopeer server.
prowlarrKey.unreachable: Prowlarr isn’t answering. Check that it’s running and try again.
prowlarrKey.notConfigured: The Kinopeer server doesn’t know Prowlarr’s address (PROWLARR_URL).
prowlarrKey.notProwlarr: The Prowlarr address on the Kinopeer server answers, but not like Prowlarr. Check PROWLARR_URL.
prowlarrKey.noServerKey: The Kinopeer server has no Prowlarr key of its own, so the saved one stays.
prowlarrKey.storage: The Kinopeer server couldn’t save the change. Check that its data folder is writable.
prowlarrKey.failed: Couldn’t save the key. Try again.
prowlarrKey.forgetFailed: Couldn’t switch to the server’s key. Try again.

limits.title: Speed limits
limits.invalid: Enter a number from {{min}} to {{max}}, or leave it empty for no limit
limits.failed: Couldn’t save the limits, or saved only some of them. Check the connection to qBittorrent and try again.
limits.failedClosed: Couldn’t save the speed limits of {{title}}, or saved only some. Open them again to check.
limits.markBoth: Speed limits: download up to {{download}}, upload up to {{upload}}
limits.valueBoth: Download up to {{download}}, upload up to {{upload}}
